source_name: Stack Exchange network data dumps — explicit TeX/MathJax

official_access.current_access: Per-site quarterly data dump from the authenticated Settings page on each Stack Exchange site
official_access.access_mode: one site archive at a time; XML files compressed as 7z; PostHistory.xml contains raw Markdown body revisions and Posts.xml supplies post metadata
official_access.mirror_rule: Prefer the authenticated official per-site dump. A community Internet Archive/Academic Torrents mirror may be used only as a byte transport mirror when the release identity, site archive, checksum provenance and mirror status are recorded explicitly; never describe a community reupload as an official Stack Exchange archive.

scope.corpus: Public question/answer revisions across Stack Exchange network sites, with particularly dense quantitative coverage in mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, engineering, economics/finance and related technical communities
structures: explicit inline TeX delimited by $...$ or \(...\)
explicit display TeX delimited by $$...$$ or \[...\]
equations, functions, distributions, recurrences, inequalities, transforms, objectives, constraints and algorithmic mathematical notation explicitly authored in post Markdown
scope.original_representation: exact TeX/MathJax-delimited substring from the selected raw Markdown body revision in PostHistory.xml
scope.batching: one Stack Exchange site archive at one verified release/snapshot per extraction/materialization batch
exclusions: Do not infer mathematics from prose in this lane
Do not harvest TeX-looking text inside fenced code, inline code, HTML code/pre, script, style or comments
Do not treat current Posts.xml HTML as the licensing timestamp when PostHistory provides the exact body revision

snapshot_policy.rule: For each site, pin a named Stack Exchange dump release, retain the acquired archive filename/source URL and published checksum evidence when available, hash the acquired .7z and the extracted PostHistory.xml/Posts.xml objects, then use stackexchange:<site>:<release>:inventory-sha256:<digest> as source_snapshot. A changed release or changed byte inventory creates a new immutable snapshot/item.

revision_rules: revision created before 2011-04-08 UTC -> CC BY-SA 2.5
revision created from 2011-04-08 UTC up to but not including 2018-05-02 UTC -> CC BY-SA 3.0
revision created on or after 2018-05-02 UTC -> CC BY-SA 4.0
license_policy.rule: Use PostHistory body revision CreationDate, not post creation date or a later unrelated title/tag edit, to attach the applicable Creative Commons version. Preserve site, post id, revision GUID/history id, user identifiers when available and a stable revisions URL for attribution. The authenticated dump download process also imposes access/use terms; therefore never republish raw .7z/XML dump files, and keep Internet Archive publication of derived equation payloads fail-closed until the run records a rights review for the exact acquisition path and intended redistribution. Metadata, code, checksums and non-payload audit records may still be persisted in Git.
license_policy.attribution: Preserve the Stack Exchange site, post/revision locator and available owner/revision user identifiers on every occurrence.

adapter.input: one extracted Stack Exchange site dump containing PostHistory.xml and optionally Posts.xml
validation: Latest raw body revision is selected from PostHistory type 2/5/8 using CreationDate and history id, rather than inferring a license from Posts.LastEditDate
expression_original is an exact substring of raw Markdown from the selected PostHistory body revision
Code/comment regions are length-preservingly masked only for detection, so emitted substrings still come from the original Markdown
Post metadata enrichment is optional and streaming; the body-revision SQLite scratch index keeps memory bounded for large sites
No OCR, prose-to-math reconstruction, symbolic equivalence or equation-family assertion occurs at extracted stage
